meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'so', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: So, here is your order.

examples.text: Я считаю, это нормально, это правильно.
examples.trans: I think it is normal, it is right.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'пробовать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'try', paired with 'пробовать'.

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.
